title: Smbclient ng: pyasn1 has quadratic-time denial of service in constructed string and indefinite-length ANY decoding…
description: A denial of service vulnerability exists in pyasn1 versions 0.6.4 and earlier used by smbclient-ng (>=3.1.0). The flaw causes quadratic-time CPU consumption when decoding constructed OCTET STRINGs or indefinite-length ANY types composed of many fragments, leading to CPU exhaustion. This affects BER and CER decoding paths and certain non-conforming DER inputs. No confidentiality or integrity impact is reported. The CVSS v3.1 base score is 7.5 (high severity).
